title: bundle suite
description:
A suite: listed bundles installed together (`bundle install @<handle>/<name>`), and what each must carry.

The suite vouches for none of its members. Each is installed as it would be by itself — reviewed on its own, under the installing machine's policy, and accepted or not by the person installing. What the suite can do is set a minimum per member, under `require`: a member that does not carry it is refused, at install and at every update.

`bundle suite add` and `bundle suite remove` edit this file, `bundle suite update` asks again what to require, `bundle suite validate` checks it against what is published now, and `bundle suite publish` writes it to an atproto account as a com.pipobscure.bundle.suite record. Or serve the file itself at an https URL: `bundle install <url>` installs it, and so does `bundle install <domain>` for a domain whose TXT record is `nsuite:<url>`.

Unknown settings are an error, so a typo cannot quietly drop a requirement.

$schema.description: This schema, so an editor can help. `bundle suite add` writes it; nothing else reads it.

name.description: What the suite is called: the record key it is published under, and what it is known by where it is installed.

title.description: A display name; the name stands in when there is none.

description.description: What the suite is for, in a sentence or two.

members.description: The listings installed together, each once. Apps are installed before plugins, whatever the order here.

listing.description: The at:// address of a com.pipobscure.bundle.listing record, with the publisher's DID.

for.description: Install it as a plugin, rather than onto the PATH: for the app installed from this listing, or into this scope — a package name, such as a suite's shared one. Without it, an app installs onto the PATH, and a plugin for the app its own listing names.

label.description: What it was added as, as typed — `@pipobscure.com/bled` — for whoever reads this file. Not published.

forLabel.description: What `for` was given as, as typed. Not published.

require.description: What the member must carry to be installed at all. Meeting it vouches for nothing: whoever installs still decides whom to accept — though they are asked about everyone the suite names once, up front, rather than member by member.

identity.description: The sigstore identity that must have signed it, e.g. a GitHub workflow.

issuer.description: The OIDC issuer that must have vouched for that identity.

attesters.description: Who must have attested it, as `[kind@]<did>`.

quorum.description: How many of the attesters must have attested it (default: all of them).
